title: Cross-functional compliance gating and evidence funnel
creator: Sofia Nguyen
description: Build an operational milestone tracker and evidence funnel that coordinates engineering, security, and compliance teams for SOC2/ISO readiness. Goal is to reduce manual evidence handoffs, introduce deterministic gating rules for SSO/SAML, and provide a single source-of-truth for audit-log retention and proof artifacts. Deliverables include: 1) milestone definitions and gating criteria, 2) an evidence ingestion checklist and owners matrix, 3) lightweight dashboard for status and stale-evidence alerts, and 4) automated links to PRs/Confluence docs and storage buckets for auditors.
milestones: M1: Define gating criteria and owner matrix - target 2025-01-31
M2: Implement evidence ingestion templates and storage paths - target 2025-02-14
M3: Integrate audit-log retention policy with infra (retention + access controls) - target 2025-02-28
M4: Console dashboard for milestone & evidence status (beta) - target 2025-03-14
M5: Cross-team rehearsal + evidence dry-run and remediation - target 2025-03-24
M6: Final audit packaging and sign-off - target 2025-03-31
acceptance_criteria: All milestones have named owners and documented acceptance checklists
Evidence storage locations (GCS/S3) are provisioned with access controls and immutable paths
SSO/SAML configuration docs and test logs are attached to each relevant milestone
Dashboard shows per-milestone status, days-stale metric, and links to source artifacts
At least one dry-run produces a complete evidence bundle within 48 hours
risks: Delayed infra changes for audit-log retention could push final sign-off
Owner bandwidth during cycle sprint may cause evidence to go stale
Incomplete mapping between product routes and audit-log producers (eg. private deployments)
Third-party identity provider (IdP) test accounts may be rate-limited during rehearsal
mitigations: Allocate a 2-week 'evidence sprint' with protected capacity for owners
Create fallbacks in gating rules that allow provisional evidence with remediation tickets
Engage infra early: weekly sync with ENG-48112 to unblock retention
Request temporary test quotas from IdP partner and schedule rehearsals off-peak
next_steps: (Liam) Finalize owner matrix and publish to Confluence by 2025-01-21
(ENG) Provision S3 buckets with retention lifecycle and document paths - ENG-48112
(Security) Draft SSO/SAML test plan and seed test users - target 2025-01-28
Schedule cross-functional dry-run for 2025-03-10 and invite auditors for scope review
